# Alert rules

The `alertas` task evaluates these rules every 10 minutes. An alert opens only after its
condition has held for the waiting period, so a blip is not an alert; it closes by itself
when the condition clears. `alerts` lists open alerts and recent events; `alerts_check`
evaluates now.

Severities are the values the program reports: `info`, `aviso` (warning) and `critico`
(critical).

| Rule | Severity | Waits | What it watches |
|---|---|---|---|
| `indice_atrasado` | `aviso` | 3600 s | (not documented yet) |
| `saude_do_vault` | `aviso` | 1800 s | (not documented yet) |
| `agenda_falhando` | `critico` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
| `sentinela_esquecida` | `aviso` | 86400 s | (not documented yet) |
| `inbox_parado` | `info` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
| `processo_parado` | `info` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
| `disco` | `critico` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
| `segredo_no_vault` | `critico` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
| `grafo_desatualizado` | `info` | no wait | (not documented yet) |
